summary: Full backend + frontend testing of RECURSIVE.BBS (stub mode). 13/13 pytest backend tests pass covering root/status, builds CRUD, feedback (+/-0.25), leaderboard sort, lineage shape, self-improvement inheritance, and fork generation increment. Frontend loads cleanly, prompt submission produces a build with rater scorecard, ASCII progress bars, critic notes, meta_builder & app_spec JSON viewers. Feedback-up boosts score (toast '→ BOOSTED INTO GENE POOL'), fork-build triggers 'FORK FROM :: <id> ✕' chip in PromptConsole (via clear-parent-btn). Leaderboard rows and lineage nodes are clickable and load the selected build.

issues: No data-testid on composite score number — minor; selector-only impact for automation.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid="composite-score" to the composite number element in BuildDetail to ease automated assertion.
Optional: add data-testid="parent-chip" to the FORK FROM chip in PromptConsole (currently only clear-parent-btn is exposed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: STUB_MODE check uses `reward.helpfulness == 0 and reward.correctness == 0` to decide stub fallback even when not in STUB_MODE — could mis-trigger if real rater legitimately returns zeros. Consider explicit success flag.
server.py: generation numbering for non-fork uses `(count % 999) + 1` which is not monotonic and can collide; consider max(generation)+1 or simple count+1.

server.py: _stub_generate uses Python built-in hash() which is salted per-process — same prompt gives different scores across restarts (note: behavior contradicts 'same prompt → same scores' claim). Use hashlib.md5 for stable seed.
server.py is ~470 lines; LLM helpers + endpoints could be split into modules but acceptable for current size.
test_credentials: n/a — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Tests insert TEST_ prefixed builds; not auto-cleaned (no delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stub mode is active (no NVIDIA_API_KEY). All 13 pytest tests pass. Frontend data-testid coverage is strong except for composite-score and parent-chip nodes. Fork button uses fork-build (not fork-btn). Leaderboard rows use leaderboard-row-<id>, lineage nodes use lineage-node-<id>. The composite-score in DB is mutable via feedback; verified +/- 0.25 swing. hash() seeding is non-deterministic across process restarts — be aware when asserting score equality across server restarts.
